# Risk model results — fs-v2 (generated by ml/run_experiment.py on 2026-09-18)

Task: at day 100 of an OULAD presentation, using the previous 28 days, predict withdrawal within the next 21 days. Features: the seven the app computes.
Dataset: 25344 enrolments active at the cutoff; withdrawal rate 0.0225.

## Deployed: `lr-v2` (logistic_regression)

Tier thresholds: watch ≥ 0.4485, at risk ≥ 0.5952 (deciles of temporal-train scores: atrisk from decile 8 (all higher deciles >= 2x base rate), watch from decile 5 (>= 1x)).
Behaviour on the held-out temporal test set:

| tier | n | share | withdrawal_rate | lift |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| healthy | 4110 | 0.4853 | 0.0078 | 0.314 |
| watch | 2565 | 0.3029 | 0.0363 | 1.4622 |
| atrisk | 1794 | 0.2118 | 0.0474 | 1.9108 |
